description: This file contains a utility function `shapeStackedSeries` that transforms raw cost records into a dataset suitable for visualization with Recharts, including handling categories, services, and zero-filling missing data. It prepares data for stacked series visualization by organizing and sorting the input records.

methods.name: shapeStackedSeries(records, stackBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms an array of cost records into a Recharts-friendly dataset with zero-filled stacks, organized by categories and services, with options for sorting and labeling.
